verdict.rationale: pnpm's workspace filtering (run tasks on just the projects you touched), single-lockfile monorepo model, and catalog: protocol (one line to upgrade dependency version across every package) all directly enable bulk operations across many packages at once, and community reports corroborate strong monorepo/bulk usage ('great for monorepos', 'everything on pnpm's built-in monorepo support just works'). missing for 10: explicit docs of a --parallel/--recursive run flag with AI-agent-friendly output, and no AI-native-specific tooling for bulk automation beyond generic CLI/workspace features.
